description: Text to speech (TTS) with persona voices: turn text into expressive spoken WAV audio with personas such as Storyteller, Narrator, Announcer, Assistant, Urgent, Sage, Spark, Anchor, Velvet or Echo. The only tool that accepts persona voices; all 20 voices with speed and steps. Best for branded agents, characters, demos and stories. Costs $0.005 for 1-500 chars or $0.01 for 501-2000 chars. Charged only for a 200 that carries audio: the service refuses with 400 before payment (charged:false) text with no letter or digit, text whose script does not match lang, non-Latin text without lang, speed outside 0.7-2.0, steps outside 1-100, or an unknown voice, lang or response_format; audio that fails its post-synthesis check answers 502 with charged:false.

lang.description: Language code, default en for Latin-script text; must match the script of the text and is required for non-Latin text

voice.description: Voice name; personas include Storyteller, Narrator, Announcer, Assistant, Urgent, Sage, Spark, Anchor, Velvet, Echo

name: generate_persona_voice
